# Xodus Nexus 0.3.3

- Add Continue in browser for Microsoft sign-in stuck on a passkey request, including first-time setup. Google Chrome must be installed on the computer; other browsers are not supported. Regular sign-in remains available.
- Prevent font-related startup crashes on minimal Linux installations.
- Remember library filters after restart and dismiss search suggestions when leaving search.
- Fix desktop shortcut launches and use readable game names for shortcut files.
- Add per-game MangoHud, gamescope and Steam-style launch options.
- Improve library layout, matching card heights, covers and wide game artwork.
- Let users choose installation packages in the launcher. Requires Nexus backend 0.2.4.

Thanks @iWr4ith for helping identify the passkey sign-in problem.
